questions.text: Which planet in our solar system is known for its prominent ring system?
questions.explanation: Saturn is famous for its extensive and complex ring system made mostly of ice particles, rocky debris, and dust.

questions.text: Which of the following spacecraft were part of NASA's Apollo program? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Apollo 11 and Apollo 13 were key missions in the Apollo program. Voyager 1 was a separate deep-space probe, and Sputnik 1 was Soviet.

questions.text: Type the missing word: The first human to journey into outer space was Yuri [blank].
questions.explanation: Yuri Gagarin, a Soviet cosmonaut, became the first human in space when his Vostok spacecraft completed an orbit of the Earth on April 12, 1961.

questions.text: The boundary around a black hole beyond which no light or other radiation can escape is called the [BLANK].
questions.explanation: The event horizon is the theoretical threshold around a black hole where the escape velocity surpasses the speed of light.

questions.text: Match the space agency to its home country or region.
questions.explanation: NASA is the USA's space agency, ESA represents Europe, ISRO represents India, and JAXA represents Japan.

questions.text: You are navigating a remote server onboard the ISS. What Linux command would you use to list all files, including hidden system files, in the current directory?
questions.explanation: The 'ls' command lists directory contents, and adding the '-a' flag ensures that hidden files (those starting with a dot) are also displayed.
